title: R(5,20) >= 426 and R(5,21) >= 447: two Ramsey graphs
description:
A graph on 425 vertices with no K5 and no independent set of size 20, and a graph on 446 vertices with no K5 and no independent set of size 21. They raise the lower bounds for the Ramsey numbers R(5,20) from 424 to 426 and R(5,21) from 445 to 447.

Both are built by Theorem 3 of Xu, Shao and Radziszowski (SIAM J. Discrete Math. 25 (2011)) from Mathon's 384-vertex cubic-residue graph and complements of graphs from B. D. McKay's lists, with larger common induced subgraphs (17 and 20 vertices) found by search under the full Theorem 3 condition. The clique side is checked directly by two independently written exact programs; the independent-set side follows from the theorem, whose hypotheses are machine-checked, and for the 425-vertex graph also from one finished direct exact search.
release_notes:
R(5,20) >= 426 (425-vertex graph) and R(5,21) >= 447 (446-vertex graph), by Theorem 3 of Xu, Shao and Radziszowski (2011) with new common parts of 17 and 20 vertices.
Includes the inputs, a standard-library rebuild, a hypothesis verifier, exact checkers and reproduce.sh.
The independent-set side rests on the theorem; README.md says which direct checks finished.
